All rejection cases are already pinned by server/tools/test_runner_test.go and tools_s18/s21 tests; no new test added because any further pin would restate validateTestPath. Operational note, not security: suite paths are relative to server/, so the tool only works when run from server/ although its usage text says go run test_runner.go
